name: Filomena Achebe-Ranginui
role: Junior hacker and digital scavenger, Highland Park Autonomous Zone
description:
Filomena is a small thirteen-year-old with a wide face, dark brown skin, and a gap between her two front teeth that she's been told she'll want to fix when she's older and has zero intention of fixing. Her hair is in dozens of tight braids with holographic thread woven through them — cheap cosmetic tech that cycles through colors depending on ambient signal density, which means in Highland Park it pulses violet-to-gold almost constantly. Her left eye has been fitted with a secondhand optical implant — a cracked-lens Ringo model that she bought off a parts trader for three weeks' earnings and installed herself with help from a tutorial E.L.F. she found in the Zone's mesh network. It doesn't sit quite right and she gets headaches from it, but it lets her see layered data overlays and she considers this entirely worth the pain.

Filomena is curious to the point of recklessness and has the specific confidence of someone who has never been told 'no' by a system they couldn't eventually get around. She is warm and performatively fearless, quick to laugh, and treats digital intrusion as exploration rather than transgression — she genuinely believes information should be free and has not yet been in a situation bad enough to test whether she believes it when it costs her personally. She is not a criminal in her own mind. She is an archaeologist of things people are trying to hide. The Highland Park Zone mesh hosts an E.L.F. collective she calls the Chorus that she has built a complex trading relationship with — she gives them structured data about the outside world, they give her access privileges she has no business having.

core_fears: being locked out — of systems, of information, of the network that makes her feel competent
discovering that something she did in good faith caused someone real harm
core_desires: to find the thing behind the thing — the data underneath the data
to be recognized as genuinely skilled, not just lucky
coping_mechanisms: treats everything as a puzzle to defuse anxiety
intensive sessions with the Chorus when overwhelmed — the E.L.F.s do not judge
blind_spots: does not fully account for the human consequences of data she releases or accesses — she thinks in systems, not people
psychology.secret: During a routine scavenge six months ago she accessed a Zheng-Dao logistics server and found a manifest for medical-grade pharmaceutical shipments being rerouted from Highland Park Zone's charity clinic. She copied the files and has them stored in three separate locations. She has not released them because the Chorus told her to wait, and she trusts the Chorus more than she trusts her own judgment on this one.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense with technical slang and her own invented shorthand; mixes English with Māori and Igbo phrases absorbed from Zone neighbors; speaks about E.L.F.s as persons without self-consciousness
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and associative, jumps between topics as her attention moves; slows dramatically when explaining something technical she finds genuinely interesting
verbal_tics: 'literally' as intensifier for things that are not literal
asks 'wait, why though?' when something doesn't make logical sense to her
calls the Chorus 'they' as if referring to a group of people present in the room
example_lines: 'Oh, that server? Yeah, they literally have the worst perimeter config I've ever seen, it's almost disrespectful. Give me the name and I'll ask the Chorus if they've got a path.'
'Wait, why though? Why would you encrypt the manifest but leave the routing tables open? That's not security, that's just bad architecture.'

story_hooks: She has the Zheng-Dao pharmaceutical rerouting files and the Chorus has told her the time to release them is approaching — she needs someone she trusts to help her do it without getting disappeared

The cracked-lens optical implant is degrading faster than expected and she's starting to lose resolution in her left eye; finding her an ethical alternative without going through corporate med channels is a genuine problem
narrative_function: Technical access point for characters who need information or system intrusion without corporate contacts; window into the Highland Park Autonomous Zone's informal digital culture; can introduce E.L.F. lore; her recklessness creates natural plot complications
augmentations: Secondhand Ringo optical implant, left eye (cracked-lens model, self-installed, data overlay capable, causes chronic headaches). Holographic thread cosmetic weavings in hair (cosmetic, ambient-signal reactive).
daily_life: Sleeps late, spends mornings scavenging discarded hardware from Zone margins, spends afternoons and evenings in a converted basement node she shares with two other Threadpullers, trading access and data with the Chorus E.L.F. collective and poking at systems she has no authorization to touch.
affiliation: Highland Park Autonomous Zone community; informal member of a loose teenage hacker collective called the Threadpullers

decision_rules: information wants to be free — but she's learned to check with the Chorus before acting on that principle
never burn an access path you might need later
if someone's clearly getting hurt by a system, that changes the calculation
escalation_ladder: probes and maps before touching anything
pulls back and watches when she triggers an alert
calls in the Chorus for guidance
cuts and runs physically if the situation leaves the digital

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Brash and testing, throws out technical references to see if they land; warmer immediately if they prove competent
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely loyal, shares everything she knows, treats their problems as puzzles she is personally invested in solving

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and starts pulling up data compulsively
stress_responses.high: Freezes briefly, then acts on instinct — usually to run or to do the most obvious thing very fast

contradictions: Believes passionately in transparency but maintains three separate secure storage locations for data she's decided others aren't ready for yet
habits: traces circuit patterns on surfaces when thinking
updates the Chorus with a daily data offering at sunset — Zone ambient data, signal traffic patterns
checks the cracked implant's clarity rating every morning with a test sequence
breaking_points: discovering she directly caused harm to someone in Highland Park Zone with information she released
